title: The Devout Woman and the Two Wicked Elders
logline: Two old garden keepers accuse a devout woman with a story they made up; a twelve-year-old boy saves her by asking each of them, alone, one simple question.
moral: Do not believe an accusation until the witnesses have been tested. One simple question, asked separately, can uncover a lie.
tone: A courtroom fable told with restraint: calm and bright in the garden, cold and still while the lie rules, then quick, clever and warm once the boy steps forward. Nothing improper or violent is ever drawn; the menace is in eyes, masks and an empty dotted outline.

beats.summary: A devout woman passes through a walled garden every morning on her way to pray.
She washes at the fountain; pear tree to the east, apple tree to the west are planted in the picture.
The two old keepers of the garden set their eyes on her and make a demand she will not accept.
They threaten to agree on a false testimony that will ruin her name.
They throw open the gate and shout for help.
The lie: a young man who ran away. The picture shows only an empty dotted outline.
Nobody checks; the one doubter is hushed.
On the fourth day, at the place of punishment, she raises her hands and prays for the truth.
A twelve-year-old boy, Daniel, comes out of the back of the crowd.
He asks that the two witnesses be heard one at a time.
First elder: the east side, under a pear tree.
Second elder: the west side, under an apple tree.
The contradiction is plain; the accusation was invented.
Legend: fire from the sky strikes the false accusers; the woman is saved.
The decisive act was a simple question that tested the witnesses.

cast.look: s 1.0. White veil with the gold band, long blue robe (the preset as drawn in people.png). Fully covered at all times. Default face: calm, lid 0.2 to 0.4, small smile; in fear her brows rise but her feet stay planted.

cast.look: Child figure (0.62 size, 1.25x head, no beard or moustache). Yellow tunic, blue cap: the brightest figure in the square so the eye finds him behind the crowd. Quick eyes, big clear gestures.

sets.description: NEW shared set, world 1600 x 1230, ground y 900. Sky by skyCycle(u) (morning u 0.04 to 0.10; the sun low on the RIGHT = east). Behind the wall at the east end a domed prayer house: block 150 x 110 with base hidden by the wall, dome r 70, top at about y 430, centred x 1480. Back wall across the whole width: top y 600, foot y 860, cream with ochre Ben-Day shading, 14 high coping, a few vine scallops. Gate in the back wall: townDoor x 720..880, top 640, bottom 860, pointed arch, two leaves, open 0..1, inside(ctx) shows a strip of street. Lawn band y 860..900 behind the path; paved path from the gate (800, 860) down to y 900 and east to x 1600. WEST (left): apple tree at x 260 (fruitTree kind apple) with the keepers' bench under it at x 400..560, seat top y 852 (anchor bench.sitY). EAST (right): pear tree at x 1340 (fruitTree kind pear). Fountain at x 1040 (planned fountain: basin 220 wide, rim top y 840; pedestal to y 770; bowl 90 wide; jet 0..1, 40 high). Front pass: two Library bushes at x 80 and x 1560. Anchors: ground, gate {x0, x1, top, cx}, bench {x0, x1, sitY}, fountain {x, rim}, apple {x}, pear {x}, dome {x, top}, wallTop.

Library marketStreet as a strip, w 2400, palace: false, palette 'clear' for S8 then 'dusk' from S9, shutters keyed for S8. Stalls: [{x: 500, kind: 'fruit'}, {x: 1650, kind: 'cloth'}] (the cloth stall is the hiding place for elder1, redrawn in the front pass). Props: [['barrel', 2340], ['crate', 2380]] (hiding place for elder2). House door used in S8 at about x 1320 (use the doors anchor nearest to it; approximate, measure on the set). The square is the right end, x 1700..2300: stonePlatform at x 2060..2260, top y 850. Questioning spot x 1890 (Daniel) and x 2010 (elder).

props.description: Fruit tree built on the Library tree(): kind 'apple': trunk 46 wide, three round crowns (r 110 to 130), crown top y 470, nine red apples r 13 with a small highlight. kind 'pear': narrower and taller, crowns r 95 over r 125, top y 430, nine yellow pears (r 11 circle with an r 8 circle above, short stem). sway(t) moves the fruit 3 px. Also drawn inside the thought clouds at scale 0.42 and as single big fruit icons (60 px) for the cards.
Planned name (AN-114): stone basin fountain with a keyed jet. Here: basin 220 x 60, rim top y 840, pedestal, bowl 90 wide, jet 0..1; ripple rings on the basin water when touched.
Iron ring r 16 with two big keys (40 long, two teeth), yellow with black outline; hangs at elder1's sash with swing(); lies on the scorch mark in S16; hangs on the open gate in S18.
Low bare stone platform 200 wide x 50 high (top y 850) with two steps on its left side (each 40 x 25), grey with dot shading and block lines. Nothing on it: no post, no stones, no ropes.

A white card with a black brush border, 300 x 220 at full size (150 x 110 when pinned): the garden map reduced to the wall line, gate and fountain, a lit half (yellow right for EAST, red left for WEST), the word, and the tree with one big fruit. flip 0..1 (face down shows plain paper with a small question mark).

Planned shared wordless picture balloon (24 films), single mode. Icons for this film: squiggle (unreadable whisper), two mouths with a bracket (agreed testimony), veil with a blot (her name), dashed empty man outline (the invented young man).

actions.action: Daniel looks up at elder1 and asks, one hand at his chin
actions.acting: talk, steady gaze up; elder1 smiles down at a mere child

actions.action: He opens both palms: where
actions.acting: brows up, head tilt; the question lettering sits beside him, not over a face

actions.action: Elder1 strokes his beard; his eyes dart up and to the side while he makes it up
actions.acting: saccades, lid 0.3; then a satisfied little nod

actions.action: He puffs up and answers; a thought cloud pops over him showing the small garden: wall, gate, fountain
actions.acting: chest out (sq 1.04), talk 0.8, eyes half shut in confidence

actions.action: He sweeps his arm to his right
actions.acting: big arm angle so it reads on a phone

actions.action: Inside the cloud the right half lights up yellow and the word lands on it with an arrow
actions.acting: stamp with a 2-frame squash

actions.action: A pear tree pops up on the lit east side of the cloud
actions.acting: grows from the ground with overshoot; pears bob

actions.action: One big yellow pear bounces beside the tree; the cloud snaps into a small card (EAST + pear) pinned at the top left of the panel
actions.acting: Daniel nods slowly; a tiny smile only while elder1 is not looking at him (mask on / off)
actions.library: hop on the pear icon + evidenceCard

scenes.summary: Daniel sends the first elder away and calls the second to tell his story alone. The two never cross.

camera.notes: x 1950, y 700, zoom 1.25. Pan 40 units left as elder1 leaves (121.1), 40 right as elder2 arrives (122.4): the swap is felt in the camera.

scenes.composition: Elder1 exits LEFT behind the cloth stall at x 1650 (front pass covers him) before elder2 enters from the RIGHT (from behind the barrels at x 2360). Daniel stays planted at x 1890 as the pivot. The card EAST + pear is pinned top left, then flips face down.

actions.action: Daniel bows his head politely to elder1
actions.acting: perfectly innocent face; blink

actions.action: Daniel waves elder1 off to the left; elder1 strolls away pleased with himself and disappears behind the cloth stall
actions.acting: smug walk, chin up, stick swinging

actions.action: Daniel turns his eyes right and beckons
actions.acting: gaze right, two beckoning curls of the hand

actions.action: Elder2 shuffles in from the right wringing his hands, trying to see past Daniel to where elder1 went
actions.acting: worried brow (-0.6), eyes sliding left; Daniel side steps into his eye line

actions.action: Daniel takes exactly the same pose as before: hand at the chin, then both palms open
actions.acting: setup and payoff: the same question, the same picture

actions.action: The EAST card flips face down so elder2 cannot read it; elder2 swallows
actions.acting: card flip is a 6-frame squeeze; elder2 drop pulse

scenes.summary: The second elder answers: the west side, under an apple tree. A second cloud draws the opposite picture.

camera.notes: Mirror of S12: twoShot(daniel, elder2), x 1950, y 700, zoom 1.5; 129.6 tilt up and out to zoom 1.15, y 560 for the cloud.

scenes.composition: Same staging as S12 on purpose (Daniel x 1890, elder2 x 2010). Cloud 560 x 400 at (1990, 380) with the SAME garden map, but now the LEFT half lights (red) and an apple tree stands there. Face-down card stays top left.

actions.action: Elder2 starts talking, eyes darting, hands still wringing
actions.acting: talk 0.6, saccades; he copies his friend's confident nod a beat too late

actions.action: The second thought cloud pops over him: the same small garden
actions.acting: same pop as the first so the audience compares

actions.action: He sweeps his arm to his LEFT
actions.acting: the mirror of elder1's gesture

actions.action: The left half of the cloud lights up red and the word lands on it
actions.acting: stamp with squash; Daniel's eyebrows shoot up (brow -0.8) for four frames, then level

actions.action: An apple tree pops up on the west side of the cloud
actions.acting: overshoot, apples bob

actions.action: One big red apple bounces; the cloud snaps into a second card (WEST + apple) top right; a villager in the crowd frowns and looks from one card to the other
actions.acting: the same villager who was hushed in S7

scenes.summary: Daniel turns the first card over. East and pear against west and apple: the two stories cannot both be true. The invented young man pops like a bubble and the crowd's eyes turn on the elders. The woman lowers her arms.

camera.notes: 135.32 x 1950, y 640, zoom 1.3. 136.6-137.4 pull out to zoom 0.95 as the two cards grow to the centre top. 139.6 pan 60 left to take in the crowd. 146.6-148.2 ease to the woman on the platform: x 2110, y 660, zoom 1.5.

scenes.composition: Two cards (each 300 x 220) side by side at panel top centre, the red unequal mark between them. Elders together below at x 1990 and 2060, Daniel x 1890, crowd left, the woman on the platform right. The cards stay above every head.

actions.action: Daniel raises one finger and flips the first card face up
actions.acting: calm face, small smile; finger arrives with overshoot

actions.action: Both cards slide to the centre and grow: EAST + pear tree on one, WEST + apple tree on the other
actions.acting: cards settle with a wobble

actions.action: A red zigzag unequal mark slashes down between the two cards; a small panel-only shake
actions.acting: the one hard accent of the film; 3-frame shake

actions.action: Elder1, brought back from the left, sees both cards beside elder2: jaws drop, they look at each other, then at the lens
actions.acting: shock: eyes wide, mouth o, settleTo; no blinks during the hold

actions.action: A gasp runs through the crowd; heads turn from the cards down to the elders
actions.acting: staggered; brows turn to an angry V aimed at the elders now

actions.action: Elder2 drops his hands; elder1's stick slips and falls
actions.acting: both shrink (sq 0.92), tip backward -0.06, tremble

actions.action: The dotted outline of the young man reappears over them and pops like a soap bubble
actions.acting: pop: ring of 8 short strokes, 5 frames

actions.action: The red testimony balloon from the garden cracks in two and falls away
actions.acting: two halves fall with gravity and fade

actions.action: The headman lowers his arm, looks at the elders, then turns to the platform and bows his head
actions.acting: shame ending pattern: look up at her, eyes break away, head drops

actions.action: The crowd steps back and opens a path; several look at their feet. The hushed villager nods to himself
actions.acting: staggered half steps back; lids low

actions.action: On the platform she lowers her arms, opens her eyes and breathes out; her eyes find Daniel
actions.acting: wet eyes, the first small smile since the garden; Daniel looks up at her
actions.library: aL/aR ease down + wet + breathe + lookAt

scenes.summary: The legend: fire from the sky strikes the two elders. Shown as a storybook picture: a flame bolt, a white flash, and afterwards only two smoking turbans, a stick and the key ring. The woman steps down, saved.

camera.notes: x 2000, y 620, zoom 0.95 with the sky open above. Panel-only shake for 0.4 s at 153.54. 156.2 ease to the platform steps: x 2090, y 700, zoom 1.3.

scenes.composition: Elders have backed away alone into the empty space LEFT of the crowd path at x 1780..1840, clear of everyone else (at least 200 units of air). Bolt enters at the panel top above them. The woman, Daniel and the crowd are on the right half and shield their eyes.

actions.action: A scalloped storybook frame closes round the picture and a caption strip says this part is the legend
actions.acting: frame draws on in 0.5 s; the elders, alone, back away from the crowd

actions.action: The sky darkens to deep blue and a yellow glow opens at the top of the panel; the elders look up, trembling
actions.acting: gaze [0, -1], brows up, tremble; crowd looks up a few frames later

actions.action: A zigzag bolt of flame comes down from the glow toward the two
actions.acting: anticipation: the glow pulses once, then the bolt draws downward in 5 frames

actions.action: A 2-frame white flash covers the strike; panel-only shake; everyone else throws up an arm to shield the eyes
actions.acting: the contact is never seen; shield gestures staggered

actions.action: The flash clears: where the elders stood there is a round scorch mark with two smoking turbans, the stick and the key ring; three smoke puffs rise
actions.acting: no bodies. Smoke puffs drift up and fade; the key ring rocks to a stop

actions.action: The woman steps down from the platform; Daniel waits at the bottom step; she puts a hand to her chest and bows her head to him
actions.acting: soft landSquash on the ground; warm eye contact, both smile; Daniel scratches the back of his head

actions.action: The empty platform; the white dove lands on it; the storybook frame opens again
actions.acting: landSquash, head tilt

scenes.summary: The moral: the most important moment was Daniel's simple question. A big question mark stands over the boy and the two cards show what it uncovered.

camera.notes: x 1900, y 680, zoom 1.4 on Daniel, slow push to 1.7 by 164.1; the surroundings drop to 45 percent tone so he stands in a pool of light.

scenes.composition: Daniel centre. Question mark (160 tall, yellow with black outline) above and slightly right of his head, never over his face. From 166.8 the two cards sit left and right of the question mark at half size.

actions.action: Push in on Daniel; the crowd and street dim to a flat tone behind him
actions.acting: he looks around, a little shy now that everyone is looking

actions.action: He rubs the back of his head and smiles
actions.acting: child body language: weight on one foot, tip 0.04

actions.action: A big yellow question mark pops above him and bounces once
actions.acting: overshoot and settle; he looks up at it

actions.action: The question mark shrinks to a small plain one sitting on his open palm
actions.acting: he holds it up like something light and ordinary

actions.action: He holds the little question mark out like a stop sign; the dim crowd silhouettes behind stop mid step
actions.acting: replay of the WAIT pose from S11

actions.action: The two cards return on both sides (EAST pear, WEST apple) and a red cross lands between them; lettering below
actions.acting: stamp with squash; Daniel nods once to the audience

scenes.summary: Back to the first picture: morning in the garden, the woman on her way to the prayer house again, Daniel waving from the gate. THE END.

camera.notes: x 1150, y 640, zoom 1.1 easing out to x 900, zoom 0.82 by 170.4; hold for THE END.

scenes.composition: Same framing as the end of S1: sun low on the right, dome beyond the east wall. Woman at x 1250 walking right, Daniel in the open gate (x 800), no keepers on the bench (the key ring hangs on the open gate). THE END in the sky band, clear of both faces.

actions.action: Morning garden; the woman walks east past the fountain toward the dome, face calm as in S2
actions.acting: the same serene lid 0.4 and smile; walk with soft footfalls

actions.action: Daniel waves from the open gate; she turns her head and lifts a hand back
actions.acting: wave on 3 beats; her gaze to him, then on to the dome

actions.action: THE END pops and holds 2.8 s; the dove crosses the sky and lands on the wall where it landed at the start
actions.acting: title overshoot and settle; fruit bobs, fountain plays; nothing else moves

ending.description: After the last word (169.92) the film is back in the morning garden of the opening: the woman walks east toward the prayer house, Daniel waves from the open gate, the dove lands on the wall. THE END pops at 170.4 in the sky band and holds to 173.18 with only the fruit, the fountain and the dove moving.

subtitles.ar: تحكي رواية قديمة عن امرأة صالحة من بني إسرائيل|اعتادت الذهاب كل يوم إلى موضع للصلاة.|وكانت تمر أولًا ببستان قريب،|فتتوضأ فيه قبل أن تتجه إلى عبادتها مطمئنة.
subtitles.en: An old story tells of a devout Israelite woman|who visited a place of prayer daily,|stopping at a nearby garden|to perform ablutions.

subtitles.ar: كان للبستان حارسان مسنان، فطمعا في المرأة|وطلبا منها ما لا تقبله. رفضت طلبهما بثبات،|فهدداها بأن يتفقا على شهادة كاذبة|تمس سمعتها إذا لم تستجب لهما.
subtitles.en: The garden had two elderly keepers|who made an improper demand. When she refused,|they threatened to ruin her reputation|with false testimony.

subtitles.ar: قالت المرأة إنها لن تستسلم لتهديدهما،|ففتح الحارسان باب البستان ورفعا أصواتهما.|اجتمع الناس مسرعين، وزعم الرجلان|أنهما رأيا المرأة مع شاب فر من المكان قبل وصولهم.
subtitles.en: She would not yield.|The keepers opened the gate, cried for help,|and falsely claimed to have caught her|with a young man who escaped.

subtitles.ar: أخذ الناس كلام الشيخين من غير تحقيق،|وطافوا باسم المرأة في الطرقات ثلاثة أيام.|وفي اليوم الرابع ساقوها إلى موضع العقوبة،|بينما كانت ترفع يديها وتدعو أن تظهر الحقيقة.
subtitles.en: The crowd accepted their accusation without checking it.|For three days they publicly shamed her,|then led her away for punishment|as she prayed for vindication.

subtitles.ar: كان خلف الموكب صبي يدعى دانيال، عمره اثنتا عشرة سنة.|تقدم وقال إنهم يجب ألا يعاقبوا المرأة|قبل الاستماع إلى الشاهدين على انفراد، فسمحوا له بأن يسألهما.
subtitles.en: A twelve-year-old boy named Daniel followed the procession.|He insisted that no punishment occur|before the witnesses were questioned separately.

subtitles.ar: سأل دانيال الشيخ الأول أين شاهد الحادثة المزعومة.|أجاب بأنها وقعت في الجانب الشرقي من الحديقة، تحت شجرة كمثرى.|ثم أبعده دانيال واستدعى الشيخ الثاني ليسمع روايته وحده.
subtitles.en: Daniel asked the first elder where the alleged incident happened.|The man said it was on the east side,|beneath a pear tree.

subtitles.ar: قال الشيخ الثاني إن الحادثة جرت في الجانب الغربي،|تحت شجرة تفاح.|عندها ظهر التناقض بين الشهادتين، وانكشف أن الرجلين اختلقا الاتهام.|لم تعد كلمة الحارسين دليلًا على ذنب المرأة.
subtitles.en: The second elder said it happened on the west side|under an apple tree.|Their contradictory stories|exposed the accusation as false.

subtitles.ar: وتقول الرواية إن نارًا من السماء أصابت الشيخين بعد ذلك،|فنجت المرأة من العقوبة.|أما أهم لحظة في الحكاية فهي سؤال دانيال البسيط|الذي منع تصديق شاهدين لم تُختبر أقوالهما.
subtitles.en: In the legend, heavenly fire then strikes the false accusers|and the woman is saved.|Daniel’s crucial act|was to test their claims.

new_assets.name: walledGarden
new_assets.description: Walled garden strip 1600 wide with a central gate in the back wall, an apple tree west, a pear tree east, a bench, a fountain and a domed prayer house beyond the east wall (all dimensions in sets.walledGarden).
new_assets.implementation: sets file function walledGarden(ctx, o) returning anchors. Bake the static part (skyless: wall rectangle with halftone shade, coping, vines as scallop strokes, lawn band, path stones, dome from a rect plus half circle) with bake(); live parts: skyCycle(ctx, o.u), townDoor for the gate (o.gate 0..1, inside callback), fruitTree sway, fountain jet, front pass with bush(). Related planned sets (orchard, palaceGarden) have other layouts; this one is the generic garden with a gate.

new_assets.name: fruitTree
new_assets.description: Apple or pear tree on the Library tree with bobbing fruit; also usable small inside clouds and cards.
new_assets.implementation: tree(ctx, x, 900, {w, top, crowns}) then loop nine seeded fruit positions (K.rng seed) drawing circles; pears are two stacked circles; sway from Math.sin(t * 1.3 + i).

new_assets.name: fountain
new_assets.description: Planned stone basin fountain with a keyed jet (AN-114); the same function.
new_assets.implementation: Rounded rect basin, blue water ellipse with Ben-Day dots, pedestal rect, bowl half ellipse, jet as three tapering white strokes scaled by o.jet; ripple() on touch times.

new_assets.name: evidenceCard
new_assets.description: The testimony card (map, lit half, word, tree and fruit) with a flip state; drawn in panel space above the heads.
new_assets.implementation: S.box style white rect with brush border; inside a clipped mini drawing using the same inside(c) function as the thought cloud; flip by scaling x through 0; draw after the world, before finish.

new_assets.name: stonePlatform + keyRing
new_assets.description: Two small props: the bare stone platform with two steps, and the key ring.
new_assets.implementation: Rects with dot shading and two block lines; ring as a stroked circle with two key shapes (rect shaft plus two teeth), rotated by swing().

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon, single mode, with four icons for this film (squiggle, two mouths, veil with blot, dashed man outline).
new_assets.implementation: Use the shared planned function if it exists when this film is built; else a rounded balloon with tail (halftone-pop box primitive plus a triangle), pop 0..1 scale with overshoot, icon callbacks. The dashed man is the person silhouette path stroked with ctx.setLineDash([10, 8]) and no fill.

new_assets.name: skyLight
new_assets.description: Planned soft cone of yellow halftone light from the top of the frame, strength 0..1 (prayers in S1, S2, S9, S18; the glow before the bolt in S16).
new_assets.implementation: Trapezoid from the panel top to the target, filled yellow at alpha 0.25 * strength with a Ben-Day dot overlay, soft edge by two nested trapezoids.

new_assets.name: skyFire
new_assets.description: A bolt of flame from the sky: zigzag path 70 wide of red with a yellow core and black brush outline drawing downward in 5 frames, then a 2-frame white flash of the whole panel, then a scorch disc (ellipse 220 x 40, black dots) and three grey smoke puffs.
new_assets.implementation: Polyline with 6 seeded zigzag points revealed by progress p; flame tongues as small triangles along it; flash is a white fillRect at alpha 1 for 2 frames; smoke with dustBurst in grey; shake inside the panel clip only. Related planned effect: skyCry (rings).

new_assets.name: streetCrowd
new_assets.description: Planned helper (AN-107) for a small crowd of person presets in two depth rows; here five fixed members with staggered entries, accordion stop, ripple reactions (gasp, nod, step back).
new_assets.implementation: Array of member records {preset, pal, s, row, x0, delay}; positions from one group position function plus offsets, each member walk() on its own xf so feet never slide; reactions through stagger(i).

owner_questions: The improper demand (P2) is shown only as the elders blocking her path and whispering behind a cupped hand with an unreadable scribble balloon; nobody touches her. Default: keep it this discreet.
The false claim (P3) is shown as an empty dotted outline of a young man running out of a balloon; the woman is never drawn with him. Default: keep.

Three days of public shaming (P4): the Arabic says they went round the streets with her name, so the film shows criers and a whisper chain with a blotted veil icon, and the woman alone at a doorway; she is not paraded. Default: keep.
The place of punishment (P4) is a bare stone platform; no stones, ropes or weapons are drawn and the kind of punishment is never shown. Default: keep.

The fire from heaven (P8) is framed as a storybook legend: bolt, white flash, then only two smoking turbans, the stick and the keys on a scorch mark; no bodies or burning figures. Default: keep this softened version.
Added companion: a white dove in the garden, on the empty platform and in the last shot (not in the script). Default: keep.
Added character business: one young villager starts to doubt and is hushed (S7), and a town headman decides for the crowd. Default: keep both.

Invented lettering: NO!, FALSE!, HELP! HELP!, DAY 1 2 3, DAY 4, DANIEL, AGE 12, WAIT!, ONE AT A TIME, WHERE?, EAST, WEST, MADE UP!, THE LEGEND SAYS..., a question mark, ASK FIRST!, PRAYER HOUSE. Default: keep (19 items with the title and THE END).
The on-screen title drops the word WICKED to fit one line pair: THE DEVOUT WOMAN AND THE TWO ELDERS. Default: use the short title.
East is drawn on the right and west on the left (sun rising on the right in the garden). Default: keep.
The last shot returns to the garden with the woman walking to prayer and Daniel waving (an added epilogue image under the final words). Default: keep.
SCRIPT: P5 English omits the last Arabic clause (so they allowed him to question them); both kept verbatim.

SCRIPT: P6 English omits the last Arabic sentence (then Daniel sent him away and called the second elder to hear his account alone); both kept verbatim, so the last English chunk stays on screen during that sentence.
SCRIPT: P7 English omits the last Arabic sentence (the keepers' word was no longer proof of the woman's guilt); both kept verbatim.
SCRIPT: P1 English omits that she went on to her worship with a peaceful heart, and P8 English paraphrases the closing sentence; both kept verbatim.
implementation_notes: Copy Library/template to Animations/AN-142; cue everything with w(p, n) from timing.json. The cue times in this plan are the word starts in planning/inputs/timeline.md.

Two worlds: walledGarden (1600 wide; S1 to S7 and S18) and townSquare = marketStreet strip w 2400 (S8 to S17). Camera values in the scenes are world centre x, y and zoom; clamp as in the template. For the strip use ctx.translate(-camX, 0) with camX = x - 500 / zoom.

East is ALWAYS screen right, west screen left: sun on the right in the garden, pear tree right, apple tree left, EAST card lights its right half in yellow, WEST card its left half in red. Elder colours follow: elder1 green and yellow (pear), elder2 red (apple).

People enter the garden through the gate in the back wall: draw arriving figures inside the townDoor inside() callback (clipped to the opening, s 0.85) until they cross the threshold, then on the path at full size. This suits the front-facing person figure.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so everybody blinks; suppress blinks (noBlink) during the held shocks at 138.48 to 139.5 and the camera look at 103.66.

Every figure always has a gaze target: use look(T, headPos, plan) per character with the plans implied by the actions; listeners look at the speaker. Crowd members never move in unison: stagger(i) 3 to 5 frames.
The same inside(c) function draws the garden map for both thought clouds and both cards: wall line, gate, fountain dot, then the lit half, the word and the fruitTree. Parameter side: 'E' or 'W'.
S12 and S14 must be staged identically (positions, camera, cloud size) so the audience compares the two answers; only the pointing arm, the lit half, the colour and the tree change.
Nobody touches the woman in any scene. Keep at least 60 units of air between her and any other figure; in S9 she walks and climbs on her own.
S16: the white flash covers the frame for 2 frames at 153.54; before it the elders stand whole, after it they are simply absent. Do not draw flames on a figure.
Lettering never covers a face: title and THE END in the sky band (y 120 to 330), cards and clouds above y 580, WAIT! and WHERE? beside Daniel on the side away from the listener.

Sound: 10 quiet effects (master 0.6) only in the listed pauses: chime 10.6, whoosh 20.75, low thud 25.2, whoosh 53.75, thud 64.9, pop 105.9, pop 120.0, chime 149.5, chime 159.3, chime 170.4. The shout, the gasp, the contradiction mark and the fire bolt fall inside continuous narration and stay silent on purpose.
The LATER card at 70.12 sits on continuous narration: keep it short (0.5 s, covered midpoint at 70.12 for the hidden cut from the garden to the street).
Subtitles: use the chunk marks in subtitles; time each chunk from the first word of the chunk in timing.json.
warnings: Mature source material (an improper demand, a false accusation of impropriety, public shaming, an implied execution, death by fire). The plan keeps all of it off screen or symbolic; see owner_questions before animating.
The narration has few pauses (nine of 0.6 s or more), so the film is nearly silent apart from the narrator: the acting has to carry the beats.
P6: the English has three sentences fewer than the Arabic in places; in P6 the third Arabic chunk has no matching English, so the English chunk 'beneath a pear tree.' stays up during it.
Crowd shots use up to 9 figures at once (5 townspeople, headman, 2 elders, woman or Daniel): keep them in two rows and check phone legibility on a contact sheet; drop to 4 townspeople if it crowds.

The person figure is front-facing only: turning away is acted with gaze, head drop and walking off, not with a back view. The 'wall of backs' in S10 is front-facing adults looking toward the platform with their eyes turned right.

walledGarden, iconBalloon, skyLight, fountain and streetCrowd are planned or new: none exists in Library yet. If iconBalloon is still missing when this film is built, a plain S.box balloon with the four icons is enough.
Arms are short (about 74 units): the raised prayer arms (81.92) and the pointing sweeps (114.44, 131.42) must use aL/aR angles, not hand targets.
